## Purpose

<!-- hand:purpose -->
> Draft — owner review pending.

The defibrillator, its synchroniser and the transcutaneous pacer as devices: energy selection, charging with a charge
time and tones, ready and auto-disarm, synchronised shocks on the next detected R wave, and the rhythm a shock leaves
behind. The pacer decides the spikes and capture the ECG draws. A clinician-educator can read what decides a shock's
outcome; an embedding developer sees the device commands and state (`l3/defib-pacer/`).
<!-- /hand:purpose -->

## Equations in words

<!-- hand:equations -->
> Draft — owner review pending.

- Charge time comes from the skin's table, interpolated; without one, a LIFEPAK-like 200 J in ≤ 7 s scaled linearly
  (research/05 §2.6 [ENG]); a charged device auto-disarms after its ready timeout (`l3/defib-pacer/defib.ts`).
- Sync mode uses its own low-latency R detector on unfiltered lead II and shocks on the next R within 60 ms
  (`l3/defib-pacer/sync.ts`).
- What is shocked decides the table: VF and polymorphic/pulseless VT, asystole or other pulseless rhythms (a shock
  changes nothing), an organised tachycardia with a pulse, or a perfusing rhythm (`l3/defib-pacer/outcome.ts`).
- VF at the first-shock energy: persists 0.1, ends in asystole/PEA 0.8 (half each), ROSC 0.1 (Schneider 2000, van Alem
  2003, Stiell 2007; research/20). The ROSC share is halved after 4 min of VF and × 0.2 after 10 min, and an energy
  below half the default halves termination [ENG] (`l3/defib-pacer/outcome.ts`).
- The state the shock lands in scales the ROSC share: antiarrhythmic occupancy (ARREST 1999, ALPS 2016), potassium
  above 6 mmol/L, coronary perfusion pressure, arrest duration and core temperature, each [ENG] with a sourced direction
  (`l3/defib-pacer/outcome.ts`).
- Synchronised cardioversion succeeds with p = pMax/(1 + (E50/E)²) per rhythm: AF E50 70 J, flutter and SVT 12 J,
  monomorphic VT 20 J; other organised tachycardias 0.8 (Page 2002, Mittal 2000, ERC 2021, Neumar 2010; research/20;
  `l3/defib-pacer/outcome.ts`).
- An unsynchronised shock within ± 40 ms of the T peak of a perfusing rhythm causes VF with p 0.3 [ENG]
  (`l3/defib-pacer/outcome.ts`).
- A scenario rule or the instructor's pre-selection wins; otherwise the outcome is drawn from the `outcome` random
  stream (`l3/defib-pacer/outcome.ts`).
- Pacing captures when the output current reaches the threshold, with demand inhibition; captured beats are ejected with
  k_rhythm 0.9 (`l3/defib-pacer/pacer.ts`, `l2/ecg/tcp.ts`).
<!-- /hand:equations -->
